flags.description: Allianz Global Investors U.S. pleaded guilty to criminal securities fraud in 2022 after three of its senior portfolio managers orchestrated a multi-year scheme to conceal the true risk of its 'Structured Alpha' funds from roughly 114 institutional investors (including pension funds), who invested around $11 billion. The fraud caused over $5 billion in investor losses; Allianz paid over $1 billion in SEC penalties plus more than $5 billion total in restitution, and AGI US was barred from advising US-registered mutual funds and certain pension funds.
